newsitem.title: USA: Berger, Talbott in Haiti for talks with Preval.
newsitem.headline: Berger, Talbott in Haiti for talks with Preval.

text.p: National Security Adviser Samuel Berger and Deputy Secretary of State Strobe Talbott held talks in Haiti on Thursday with Haitian President Rene Preval and other top officials.
White House spokesman Mike McCurry said the officials had a full day of meetings there.
He said they reviewed Haiti's continued efforts at democratic reform and ways to limit violence.
At least one person was wounded and some 56 houses were burned in gang warfare in a Port-au-Prince slum on Thursday, Haitian police said.
